OpenAI ships GPT-7 and a new API

OpenAI on Thursday released GPT-7, its most capable model to date, alongside a redesigned API that the company says cuts latency for long-running agent tasks by roughly half.

The model was trained on a mix of public and licensed data and posts state-of-the-art results on several coding and reasoning benchmarks, according to a technical report published alongside the launch.

Developers will get access starting today through the new Responses endpoint, while consumer availability in ChatGPT will roll out over the next two weeks, beginning with paid subscribers.

Pricing is set at a lower rate per million input tokens than the previous generation, a move analysts say is aimed at enterprise customers weighing open-weight alternatives.
